mapper.select: WITH user_dates AS ( -- 유저별 책 등록 날짜 (중복 제거) SELECT DISTINCT user_id, DATE(registered_at) AS reg_date FROM user_books ), ranked AS ( -- 날짜 내림차순으로 row number 부여 SELECT user_id, reg_date, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY reg_date DESC) AS rn FROM user_dates ), streak_groups AS ( -- date + rn 값이 같으면 연속된 날짜 → 그룹별 카운트 SELECT user_id, DATE_ADD(reg_date, INTERVAL rn DAY) AS grp_key, COUNT(*) AS streak_len FROM ranked GROUP BY user_id, DATE_ADD(reg_date, INTERVAL rn DAY) ), current_streaks AS ( -- 오늘(grp_key = 내일) 또는 어제(grp_key = 오늘)까지 이어진 streak만 SELECT user_id, MAX(streak_len) AS consecutive_days FROM streak_groups WHERE grp_key IN ( DATE_ADD(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 DAY), CURDATE() ) GROUP BY user_id ), weekly AS ( -- 최근 7일 등록 권수 SELECT user_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM user_books WHERE registered_at >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 7 DAY) GROUP BY user_id ) SELECT RANK() OVER (ORDER BY weekly.cnt DESC) AS `rank`, u.username, weekly.cnt AS weeklyCount, IFNULL(cs.consecutive_days, 0) AS consecutiveDays FROM users u JOIN weekly ON u.user_id = weekly.user_id LEFT JOIN current_streaks cs ON u.user_id = cs.user_id WHERE u.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY weeklyCount DESC LIMIT 100
